products.title: Luxury Tennis Holiday in Tuscany
products.shortDescription: Red clay and Brunello: a private Tuscan retreat.
products.description:
_**Our standard package includes a minimum stay of 4 nights for 2 people (double room accommodation). Contact us to tailor the trip to your needs.**_

Tuscany follows its own rhythm, and so does Castiglion del Bosco. Wake up to the scent of cypress trees and sun-warmed stone before heading down to a clay court framed by vineyards. Here, the game follows the sunlight: rejuvenating rallies in the morning or late afternoon sessions when the hills turn to gold.

With courts reserved exclusively for guests, the only sounds are the bounce of the ball and the breeze through the olive trees. Four days is the ideal amount of time to find your balance: a routine of tennis, slow breakfasts, and relaxation, with plenty of time to explore the 4,200 hectares of the Val d’Orcia.

products.title: Roland-Garros 2026: Private Box & Hospitality Packages

children.text: Telva Alta is a stunning historic country house whose original core dates back to the 1600s, built on the site of a pre-existing Roman watchtower. Situated above the town of Feltre in a privileged panoramic location, the residence has been renovated to the highest architectural standards while retaining all its historic charm.

The living area is spacious and bright, featuring a fully equipped open kitchen and large windows that look out onto the surrounding greenery. The sleeping area includes a master bedroom, a bedroom with bunk beds, a bathroom with a shower, and two comfortable sofa beds, accommodating up to 6 guests.

Outside, there is a large garden with a playground and a spacious porch—perfect for lunch, dinner, or simply relaxing on summer days. The house is part of the Dimore Dolomiti collection, a selection of historic homes in the heart of the Veneto region.
The owner personally welcomes each guest, ensuring an authentic experience with attention to every detail. Bed linens and towels are included.

raw.shortDescription: Your tennis court among the world's most beautiful mountains
raw.description:
_**Our standard package includes a minimum stay of 4 nights for 2 people (double room accommodation). Contact us to tailor the trip to your needs.**_

### For Players
At **Telva Alta**, you’ll wake up to a breathtaking view of the **Belluno Dolomites**, with the exclusive privilege of a private course just steps from your bed. Officially designated by Wilson as **"the most beautiful in the world"** for its extraordinary blend of architecture and Alpine peaks, this course requires no reservations: it is yours, without limits, for the entire duration of your stay. Every rally becomes a unique sensory experience, immersed in the scent of grass and the silence of the peaks, with the opportunity to perfect your swing thanks to a professional instructor available upon request.

The rhythm of the day follows the sunlight, shifting from the energy of morning matches to the absolute relaxation of the grand veranda, ideal for al fresco lunches or sunset aperitifs. Chosen by the world’s leading sports brands as an exceptional setting for their collections, this place elevates tennis to pure emotion, offering a perfect balance between athletic performance and contemplation of nature.

### For Guests
Those who don’t play tennis certainly won’t be bored. Telva Alta is a peaceful retreat surrounded by nature, ideal for reading a book in the garden, strolling through the surrounding countryside, or simply enjoying the silence of the mountains. Just a 5-minute drive away, Feltre offers a charming historic center, artisan shops, and restaurants where you can savor local cuisine.

For adventure lovers, the Belluno Dolomites offer hikes for all skill levels, from scenic treks to walks in the National Park. And for a different kind of day out, the Pedavena brewery and the villages of Valbelluna are just a short drive away.

**All-inclusive, stress-free**

Breakfast every morning, a private home with all the comforts, a tennis court for exclusive use, bed and bath linens, and personalized hospitality. All you have to do is arrive and play.
